title.narrative: Himachal Pradesh Clean Energy Transmission Investment Program - Tranche 3

description.narrative: The proposed tranche 3 for $105 million will fund (i) physical investments in transmission infrastructure, including high-voltage lines and transmission substations; and (ii) investments in upgrading the enterprise resource planning (ERP) system and related components. The government submitted a periodic financing request on 24 November 2017 outlining the tranche subprojects as well as techno-economic assessment and environmental and social safeguards review and analysis.

Output: New transmission system assets made operational. Indicator: 1b. Three substations and one switching station commissioned (2017 baseline: 0)d • 22/66 kV, 2x10 MVA GIS substation at Nirmand • 132/220 kV, 2x100 MVA GIS substation at Mazra • 33/132 kV, 2x31.5 MVA GIS substation at Barsaini • 220 kV GIS switching station at Hatkoti Achievement: 0 Progress/Status: (i) Work of 22/66 kV, 2x10 MVA GIS substation at Nirmand (34-SS) is under implementation. Overall, 99% progress has been achieved. (ii) Work of 132/220 kV, 2x100 MVA GIS substation at Mazra (35-SS) is under implementation. Overall, 45% progress has been achieved. (iii) Work of 33/132 kV, 2x31.5 MVA GIS substation at Barsaini (19-SS) is under implementation. Overall, 67% progress has been achieved. (iv) Work of 220 kV GIS switching station at Hatkoti (25-SS) is under implementation. 100% completed. (v) 132/220 kV, 1x80/100 MVA GIS substation at Charor. (Shifted from T2 to T3) - 80% progress has been achieved. (vi) 132/220 kV, 2x100 MVA GIS P.S.at Sunda. (Shifted from T2 to T3) - Overall 95% progress has been achieved. (vii) 66/220 kV, 80/100 MVA Transformer in the yard of 400/220 kV Gumma substation in Distt. Shimla (Addl. work) - 95% progress has been achieved. (vii) Augmentation of existing 220/132 kV Kangoo substation and stringing of 2nd circuit of 220 kV S/C line on D/C towers from Dehar Powerhouse of BBMB to Kangoo substation (Addl work) - 25% progress has been achieved. (viii) Joint Control and Operations Center for the transmission assets of HPPTCL/ HPSEBL (addl. work) - 85% progress has been achieved. (ix) Auxiliary work (Addl work) - (a) Auxiliary Building Wangtoo - 35% progress has been achieved; (b) Auxiliary Building Chambi - 100% progress has been achieved; (c) Auxiliary Building Charor - 80% progress has been achieved. Data Source: 1a-b. HPPTCL annual reports.
[Secondary sources: HPERC reports and tariff orders.]

Output: New transmission system assets made operational. Indicator: By 2021: 1a. Overall, 70% progress has been achieved. (ii) Work of 66 kV D/C line from Nirmand to Kotla (33 TL) is under implementation. Overall, 82% progress has been achieved. (iii) Work of 220 kV D/C line from Mazra to Karian (30-TL) has completed 100%. (iv) Work of 400 kV D/C line from Lahal to Chamera (26-TL) is under implementation. Overall, 80% progress has been achieved. (v) Work of 220 kV D/C line from Bajoli Holi HEP to Lahal (24-TL) has completed 100%. (vi) 66 kV D/C Line from 66 kV switching station at Urni to Wangtoo substation. (Shifted from T2 to T3) - 98% progress has been achieved. (vii) 220 kV D/C Transmission Line from Sunda to Hatkoti. (Shifted from T2 to T3) - 98% progress has been achieved. (viii) LILO of 132kV DC Kurthala- Bathri Transmission line at Mazra (Addl work) - 100% completed. (ix) LILO of 2nd circuit of 220 kV Kunihar - Panchkula transmission line at 220 kV substation Baddi. (Distt. Solan). (Addl work) - 100% completed. Data Source: 1a-b. HPPTCL annual reports.
[Secondary sources: HPERC reports and tariff orders.]
